CustomField.description: Rich-text content rendered at the bottom of the page body, below the page's sections, by the formTemplatePageSection LWC (lightning-formatted-rich-text bound to Page_Footer__c). Use it for closing notes, disclaimers, attestations, or links shown after the respondent has filled the page's fields. Also included in FormTemplate_PDF_Controller output. Distinct from the template-level navigation footer/buttons. HTML field.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Add rich text that appears at the bottom of the page, below its form sections — good for disclaimers, attestations, or closing instructions. This is the page body footer, separate from the form's navigation buttons; leave it blank if the page needs no closing content.
CustomField.label: Page Footer
